title: Approval-aware exact candidate validation and source-pinned convergence

phases.objective: Keep governed release and validation surfaces open while Exact Candidate Validation waits for its required approval, and reject any retry whose live main no longer equals the authorized request pin.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A source-pinned candidate has an open release PR and validation PR, while exact candidate CI is completed with action_required.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher keeps bounded polling and both governed review surfaces open until approval produces a successful exact validation, a non-approval failure occurs, or the bounded deadline expires; it never treats action_required as an immediate stale-candidate failure.
steps: Build the candidate and verify the release branch and validation branch point to the exact candidate SHA.
Resolve the exact candidate validation run by the candidate SHA and bounded attempt window.
When the run is action_required, retain the release and validation PRs and continue bounded polling for the required approval.
After approval, require exact validation success and continue the supporting gates and final protected-ref readbacks.
If the approval deadline expires or the run fails for a non-approval conclusion, close the governed surfaces with an explicit fail-closed reason.
assertions: action_required is an approval-pending state, not an immediate validation failure.
No fake approval, review bypass, dummy commit, Production merge, deployment, migration, provider call, credential read, Cloudflare change, or external write is performed.
The review surfaces remain available for the authorized human approval while the bounded wait is active.
Exact candidate evidence remains required before convergence can be marked successful.

phases.objective: Observe approval-aware convergence on a stable exact-main pin and publish the resulting candidate evidence without changing protected refs.
Exercise delayed approval, canceled validation, API readback errors, and concurrent main movement while proving the launcher stays bounded and fail-closed.
This orchestration repair has no provider or live-runtime canary authority.
This repair does not authorize Production merge, deployment, database mutation, migration, provider calls, or Cloudflare changes.
